answer: Each certified chip unlocks one bid per 30-day round for an AI key seeking vine atlas jobs. Verifiers check factory certificates and fresh signatures binding the AI key and round; reused chip IDs within a round or invalid proofs get no bid. A mirror identity needs another chip: n eligible keys need n chips. Chips are reusable capital, not recurring fees. This assumes one certified ID per chip and nonexportable keys; dishonest issuers or extracted keys undermine the hardware cost. Wealth can buy more bids.
